name: manual_515332
claim: gbrain sources can become stale (last synced 3+ days ago). Warning: 'Source X last synced Nd ago — brain search is stale!'. Fix: run 'gbrain sync --source <id>' to re-sync specific source, or 'gbrain sync' to sync all. Session 2026-07-04: Perpetua-Tools had 2300+ skipped files but 17 pages imported successfully after config fix. Stale index doesn't mean broken—just means search results may be out of sync with latest code.

decisions.notes: gbrain doctor reported 3 sources stale (3d, 3d, 6d ago). Sync freshness affects search result quality but not correctness. Full reimport after config fix brought all files into Ollama embeddings. Recommendation: run 'gbrain sync' periodically (part of CI or morning routine) to keep index current.
